name: Camp Cedarwood
description_short: A summer camp at Barrington Baptist Church with a different theme each week: cooking, sports and games, music and art, science and nature, and water fun. Each week includes a beach or Spring Lake trip plus one other field trip, such as the zoo or bowling.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camp Cedarwood's own registration page on Church Center: 'Camp Cedarwood - Summer 2026', 29 June to 31 July 2026, five themed weeks, location Barrington Baptist Church, 25 Old County Rd, Barrington, RI 02806. Pricing: 5 week deal $1180 (= $236/wk, expired 3/16), individual week $265 to April 19, then $295 from April 13 or until full; price_per_week is the $295 standard rate. Cooking week runs 6/30 to 7/2 with no camp Friday 7/3, and the page gives no separate price for it, so its price is left empty. camp_type day: the page describes daytime activities and field trips and no overnight stays. Registration closed; past season, so availability unknown.

Researched by Claude from this page. Barrington Baptist Church home page; its site menu links 'Camp Cedarwood' (to bbcri.org/cedarwood, which now returns 404). Same address, 25 Old County Road, Barrington.

warnings: The church's own camp page (bbcri.org/cedarwood) still appears in the church site menu but returns 404, so the listing uses the camp's Church Center registration page.
The registration page gives no ages or grades. A third party directory says ages 6 to 14 and overnight; that was not used.

changes: Found the current page at https://campcedarwoodri.churchcenter.com/registrations/events/3467719 after https://www.bbcri.org/cedarwood failed (404; the church site menu still links it)
Recorded the 2026 season: five themed weeks June 30 to July 31, 2026, $295 per week standard ($265 early, $236 per week with the expired 5 week deal).
Operator and Baptist affiliation from the Barrington Baptist Church home page, which links Camp Cedarwood in its menu.
for_andrew: No age or grade range is published on the camp's own pages. Ask the owner for ages before promoting; a family can't tell from this listing who the camp is for.
camp_type is day because the page describes daytime activities and field trips at the church; it never says 'day camp' outright. A directory calls it overnight, which looks wrong.
Cooking week is three days (6/30 to 7/2); the page gives no separate price for it, so that session's price is empty.
